Our sign-up endpoint starts rejecting good sign-ups after a bad one has come
in. Restarting the service makes it work again until the next bad form.

Reproduced in a fresh interpreter: the first form has no name and is rightly
refused; the second form is fine but is refused with the first one's error.

>>> from formcheck.rules import validate
>>> validate({"name": "", "email": "kim@example.org", "age": "31"})
Traceback (most recent call last):
  ...
formcheck.rules.ValidationError: name is required
>>> validate({"name": "Lee", "email": "lee@example.org", "age": "27"})
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<stdin>", line 1, in <module>
  File "/srv/signup/venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/formcheck/rules.py", line 24, in validate
    raise ValidationError("; ".join(problems))
formcheck.rules.ValidationError: name is required
